verdict.rationale: Unleash documents official SDKs on both sides of the stack: 15 official client and server SDKs, over 30 SDKs in total, backend SDKs, and client SDKs that use frontend tokens which are safe to expose client-side. Community evidence confirms official backend clients for Java, Node.js, Go, Ruby and Python. Missing for 10: no evidence naming official mobile SDKs, no documentation of consistent flag evaluation behavior across SDKs, and no hands-on corroboration of cross-stack consistency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use official SDKs across my whole stack — backend, web, and mobile — with consistent flag behavior

citations.quote: It supports 15 official client and server SDKs and over 15 community SDKs.
With over 30 SDKs, we enable fast and secure feature flagging across all major programming languages.
use one of the client or backend SDKs to connect Unleash with your application
Frontend tokens are not considered secret and are safe to expose client-side.
Backend tokens for connecting backend SDKs or Unleash Edge to Unleash.
